# Mario-head stretch preset v1

# SM64 music presets v1
[CHEAT]
NAME=Audio\Music experiments\Fast music - 240 BPM (approximation)
NOTE=SM64 US v1.0 / verified compatible US-based extensions. Locks background and secondary music to 240 BPM. Song tempo changes; note pitch and gameplay speed do not. This is an absolute tempo, not a 2x multiplier. Inspired by the requested Vinesauce references at 10:23 and 11:49: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FkEyF8hibWQ. Approximation from the described effects; the reference audio was not measured or matched. Enable after boot, one Audio preset at a time. Tempo affects players 0/1; the sound-effect player's tempo is untouched. Disabling restores owned bytes. Already scheduled notes keep their duration/pitch until they end; a song change can establish a newer original tempo. Layout guards suppress incompatible writes. Source: https://github.com/n64decomp/sm64/blob/9921382a68bb0c865e5e45eb594d9c64db59b1af/src/audio/seqplayer.c and src/audio/internal.h. Generated Jario64+ preset; chained D1 guards use this engine's conditional semantics.
GROUP=sound
ENABLED=false

NAME=Audio\Music experiments\Frenzied music - 288 BPM (approximation)
NOTE=SM64 US v1.0 / verified compatible US-based extensions. Locks background and secondary music to 288 BPM, close to the tested US engine's 299 BPM tick limit. Absolute tempo, not a speed multiplier. Inspired by the requested Vinesauce references at 10:23 and 11:49: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FkEyF8hibWQ. Approximation from the described effects; the reference audio was not measured or matched. Enable after boot, one Audio preset at a time. Tempo affects players 0/1; the sound-effect player's tempo is untouched. Disabling restores owned bytes. Already scheduled notes keep their duration/pitch until they end; a song change can establish a newer original tempo. Layout guards suppress incompatible writes. Source: https://github.com/n64decomp/sm64/blob/9921382a68bb0c865e5e45eb594d9c64db59b1af/src/audio/seqplayer.c and src/audio/internal.h. Generated Jario64+ preset; chained D1 guards use this engine's conditional semantics.

[CHEAT]
NAME=Audio\Music experiments\Gag me with a rake - dissonance (approximation)
NOTE=SM64 US v1.0 / verified compatible US-based extensions. Scrambles the note scale with repeating -12, +7, -5, +12, -7, +1, +10, -10, +5, -2, +8, -6 semitone offsets. Keeps the current song tempo. This bends the melody; it does not reproduce corrupted instrument samples. Inspired by the requested Vinesauce references at 10:23 and 11:49: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FkEyF8hibWQ. Approximation from the described effects; the reference audio was not measured or matched. Enable after boot, one Audio preset at a time. Tempo affects players 0/1; the sound-effect player's tempo is untouched. Disabling restores owned bytes. Already scheduled notes keep their duration/pitch until they end; a song change can establish a newer original tempo. Layout guards suppress incompatible writes. Source: https://github.com/n64decomp/sm64/blob/9921382a68bb0c865e5e45eb594d9c64db59b1af/src/audio/seqplayer.c and src/audio/internal.h. Generated Jario64+ preset; chained D1 guards use this engine's conditional semantics.

NAME=Audio\Music experiments\Gag me with a rake - fast dissonance (approximation)
NOTE=SM64 US v1.0 / verified compatible US-based extensions. Combines the dissonant note scale with 240 BPM background/secondary music. Inspired by the requested Vinesauce references at 10:23 and 11:49: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FkEyF8hibWQ. Approximation from the described effects; the reference audio was not measured or matched. Enable after boot, one Audio preset at a time. Tempo affects players 0/1; the sound-effect player's tempo is untouched. Disabling restores owned bytes. Already scheduled notes keep their duration/pitch until they end; a song change can establish a newer original tempo. Layout guards suppress incompatible writes. Source: https://github.com/n64decomp/sm64/blob/9921382a68bb0c865e5e45eb594d9c64db59b1af/src/audio/seqplayer.c and src/audio/internal.h.
